_comment: S-13b doc-ref-integrity allowlist. A canon doc may legitimately cite a path absent on disk: runtime-generated artifacts, frozen/per-version capsules, removed-by-design dead-tree paths (the live-CODE layer is guarded by cutover-completeness.js), planned/aspirational scripts named in ROADMAP/WARPOS, historical change-log/ADR descriptions, or per-domain-generated scaffolds. List target PREFIXES (startsWith, forward slashes) and exact LITERALS. Per-line `<!-- doc-ref-ignore -->` in the doc is the inline escape hatch for self-documenting/anti-example lines. Keep this honest — every entry must read as 'this path is SUPPOSED to be absent', not 'I don't want to fix it'. Prefer fixing a genuine navigational stale ref over allowlisting it.
_note_framework_templates_rename: The three `framework/templates/...` literals at the tail of `literals` (DATA_AND_ACCOUNTS.md.tmpl, app-scaffold/.env.local.example.tmpl, app-scaffold/FOUNDERS_CHECKLIST.md.tmpl) are PRE-EXISTING historical change-log/tracker references to the pre-rename `framework/templates/` prefix, which was renamed to `_warpos/templates/` (ownership-manifest work, SP-20260522-001; ED-008). Those are immutable historical records — rewriting them would falsify the change-log — so they are allowlisted as legitimately-absent under the '_comment' historical-change-log category, NOT as unfixed navigational staleness. Added during SP-20260716-003 (composer) only because they blocked merge-guard for an unrelated commit; they pre-date this sprint. Debt-ref: the real fix is discharged when the framework/templates→_warpos/templates migration debt closes; drop these entries then.
